description: This file defines the Compiler class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for compiling Twig nodes into PHP code.

classes.name: Twig\Compiler
classes.description: A class that compiles Twig nodes into PHP code, managing source code generation, indentation, and debug info.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the Environment object associated with this compiler.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current source code being generated.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the compiler state for a new compilation, optionally setting indentation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a given Node object, applying proper indentation and handling deprecation warnings for echo usage.

methods.name: subcompile
methods.description: Subcompiles a Node, optionally with raw output, maintaining indentation and state.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Appends a raw string to the generated source code.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes strings to the source code with proper indentation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Adds a quoted string to the source code, escaping special characters.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Converts a value into its PHP code representation and appends it to source.

methods.name: addDebugInfo
methods.description: Adds debugging information linked to a Node, including line numbers.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for subsequent lines.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level, throwing an exception if it would become negative.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique variable name for use within compiled code.

methods.name: checkForEcho
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with echo or print and updates the didUseEcho flag.
